texte.wizard:pvwiz.applicableSituations/gehirn: as a result of brain damage, my ability to gain insight, make decisions, and make contact with other people has, in the assessment of two experienced physicians (who may be named), in all likelihood been irretrievably lost, even if the time of death cannot yet be foreseen. This applies to direct brain damage, e.g. from an accident, stroke, or inflammation, as well as to indirect brain damage, e.g. after resuscitation, shock, or respiratory failure. I am aware that in such situations the capacity for sensation may be preserved and that waking from this state cannot be entirely ruled out, but is unlikely.

texte.wizard:pvwiz.lifeSustainingMeasures/auss: that everything medically possible and reasonable be done to keep me alive.
texte.wizard:pvwiz.lifeSustainingMeasures/unte: that all life-sustaining measures be withheld. Hunger and thirst should be satisfied in a natural way, with assistance in taking food and fluids if necessary. I wish for proper care of the mouth and mucous membranes, as well as dignified accommodation, attention, personal hygiene, and the relief of pain, breathlessness, nausea, anxiety, restlessness, and other distressing symptoms.
texte.wizard:pvwiz.painAndSymptomTreatment/mit: if all other medical options for pain and symptom control fail, also agents with consciousness-impairing effects, for symptom relief.
texte.wizard:pvwiz.acceptsLifeShorteningFromPa: I accept the unlikely possibility that pain- and symptom-relieving measures may unintentionally shorten my life.
texte.wizard:pvwiz.artificialNutritionAndHydra: that artificial nutrition and fluid intake be started or continued, if this can prolong my life.
that artificial nutrition and/or artificial fluid intake take place only where palliative care is indicated, for symptom relief.

that no artificial nutrition be given, regardless of the form of artificial delivery (e.g. feeding tube through the mouth, nose, or abdominal wall, intravenous access), and no artificial fluid intake be given.
that an emergency physician not be called or, if one is called in, that they be informed immediately of my refusal of resuscitation measures.

that no artificial ventilation be performed, or that ventilation already started be discontinued, provided that I receive medication to relieve breathlessness. I accept the possibility that these medications may impair consciousness or unintentionally shorten my life.

texte.wizard:pvwiz.einleitung:
This directive is built from the official text modules of the Federal Ministry of Justice (Bundesministerium der Justiz). You answer question by question; at the end, {marke} assembles a printable document from your answers in the official wording — {marke} does not draft any wording of its own, it only arranges the modules you have chosen, in the official order.

Important: to take effect, you must print the finished document, add the place and date, and sign it by hand.

There are a number of questions. You can pause at any time — your answers remain saved.

texte.situation:geburt.einfuehrung: Everything to take care of around the birth — and where the paperwork belongs. You can set up a separate, independently encrypted depot for the child — the button for it sits in the “My people” area, next to the children list, once the child has been entered there.
texte.situation:volljaehrig.einfuehrung: At 18, or when moving into your first place of your own, a lot of things need to be arranged for the first time — here you gather what's coming up and where the paperwork is kept. A child can take their own depot with them once they turn 18: the parents hand over the encrypted file, and the child opens it like any other depot via “Already have a depot? Open file” and sets their own password under Settings — no further involvement from the parents needed. The parents' copy stays readable with the old password; taking a copy doesn't invalidate it.
texte.situation:hauskauf.titel: Buying a House or Getting Married
texte.situation:hauskauf.einfuehrung: Two big steps that often coincide — a home of your own and a wedding. Here you gather what needs to be arranged with the notary, the registry office, and the bank.
texte.situation:notar.titel: At the Notary or the Bank
texte.situation:notar.einfuehrung: An appointment with the notary or the bank is coming up — for a power of attorney, a will, or access to your accounts. Here you can see what's already on file, and gather what you need to bring and arrange.
texte.situation:arzt.einfuehrung: Everything together before the appointment: what you want to ask, what to bring — and what's already on file: medications, diagnoses, insurance.
texte.situation:einfach-so.einfuehrung: No special occasion — just because it's time. The essentials at a glance; start wherever you like — each line takes you to the right area.
texte.situation:krankenhaus.einfuehrung: A hospital stay is coming up. Here you'll find everything the hospital needs to know together in one place — and what to arrange before you go: your bag, your home, and who to contact.
texte.situation:pflegeheim.einfuehrung: Moving into a care home is a big step. Here you'll find together what the facility and the long-term care fund need — and what to arrange around the move: the contract, the costs, and the old home.
texte.situation:todesfall-uebernahme.einfuehru: After a death, you often need to take over a depot that someone else set up. Here you'll find the necessary steps laid out in order — what to obtain, how to get access to the data, and what to keep in mind legally.

texte.situation:todesfall-uebernahme#die-erste: Obtain the death certificate — you'll need it for nearly every further step. Also check whether a power of attorney valid beyond death exists: it can make access to accounts and contracts much easier.
texte.situation:todesfall-uebernahme#ueberblic: Get an overview of which sub-depots the deceased person managed — for example for children or other people entrusted to their care. If the deceased person left their own recommendations for succession, you'll find them in their own records.
texte.situation:todesfall-uebernahme#ein-sub-d: A sub-depot is handed over as an encrypted file and can be added to your own management without needing to be re-encrypted. To do this, open the “Managed depots” overview in your depot (in the sidebar) and select “Mount depot” there.

If you yourself manage a sub-depot that should now pass to an authorized person, “Managed depots” offers two paths with different consequences. “Export encrypted file” hands out a copy — your own management stays in place, and you can export again at any time. “Handover complete — remove from my management” with the option “I'm handing it over.” deletes the envelope on your side — irreversible; re-adding it to your management later is then blocked.
texte.situation:todesfall-uebernahme#zugang-zu: You mount a handed-over sub-depot into “Managed depots” as described in step 3 — the file stays sealed with its own password, which must be communicated to you separately. For a handed-over sub-depot, this is the only way. Only if you instead have the complete depot file of the deceased person itself, and they had set up a compartment for you during their lifetime, do you open it via the welcome page with “Open file” and the password they gave you or left on file for this purpose — reachable only from outside an already-open session, i.e. via the home page.
texte.situation:todesfall-uebernahme#rechtlich: A power of attorney can also remain valid beyond death. Whether that is the case for yours follows first from its wording; if it says nothing on the point, have it clarified by a lawyer. Authorised persons and heirs are two different roles. This text does not replace legal advice.
texte.situation:todesfall-uebernahme#digitale-: The deceased person left information about a digital recreation on file. You'll find the complete document under “Provisions & legal”.

texte.wizard:gebwiz.geburt_urkunde.hilfetext: You apply for the birth certificate at the registry office. It is needed for parental allowance, child benefit and health insurance.

texte.wizard:gebwiz.geburt_kindergeld.frage: Where do things stand with child benefit?
texte.wizard:gebwiz.geburt_kindergeld.hilfetex: Another family member also changes your emergency supplies — the number of people for the supply calculation in Crisis preparedness adjusts automatically as soon as you enter the name in the next step.

If the name is already decided, enter it here — {marke} will then add your child under “My people”. If it isn't decided yet, leave the field blank: you can add the name later at any time under “My people” — all your other entries will still be saved.

A birth date you already know contributes to the person entry. If the birth hasn't happened yet, leave the field blank and add the date later.

The default is “biological child” — for an adopted, foster or stepchild, choose the matching option.

texte.wizard:pflwiz.einleitung: When someone needs long-term care, a lot has to be arranged at once. We'll go through the key points — care level, home-care service, money, who provides the care, and whether your provisions are in place. You can pause at any time.
texte.wizard:heirwiz.einleitung: Marriage or a registered civil partnership changes a lot at once — name, marital property regime, tax class, provisions. We'll go through the points so nothing gets missed. You can pause at any time.
texte.wizard:umzwiz.einleitung: A move brings many small steps with it — re-registration, address changes, utility providers, the old home. We'll gather what needs doing and record what's already done. You can pause at any time.
texte.wizard:kiwiz.einleitung:
AI systems can use your digital traces to create a recreation of you — as a chatbot, voice or avatar. Here you decide whether that should be allowed after your death, and under what conditions.

Unlike the advance directive, this directive is not based on official templates but on research (Edilife/Cambridge/Zurich). You answer question by question; at the end {marke} puts together a printable draft. You can pause at any time.
texte.wizard:anamwiz.einleitung:
A few questions about your medical history — so you have it ready for doctor's appointments, referrals and hospital admissions, and nothing important is missing in an emergency.

For some fields you can choose from suggestions; free text is always possible. You can pause at any time.

texte.strings:einstSchnellstartIntro.text: Five steps from opening the app to completing your first occasion.

texte.strings:schnellstartSchritt2.text: Set a password. It encrypts your file; without this password, the file can no longer be opened later — not even by us.
texte.strings:schnellstartSchritt3.text: Choose an occasion — such as “Birth of a child” or “Buying a home or getting married”. Each occasion takes you to the entries that belong to it.

texte.hilfe:depot-anlegen-passwort.titel: Creating your depot, and your password
texte.hilfe:depot-anlegen-passwort.einleitung: A depot is an encrypted collection of your own records. You create it yourself and choose a password while doing so. That password is the only key: it unlocks your depot on this device and every backup copy you make of it.
texte.hilfe:depot-anlegen-passwort.abschnitt0: Nobody can reset your password, and that includes us. No office holds a copy, and there is no way around it. If the password is gone, the depot stays closed and the records inside cannot be read. So choose one you will remember, and write it down as well.
texte.hilfe:depot-anlegen-passwort.abschnitt1: Keep what you wrote down away from the device and away from the USB stick, ideally where you keep your important papers. Anyone who has both the file and the password can open the depot, so the two do not belong in the same envelope or the same drawer.
texte.hilfe:depot-anlegen-passwort.abschnitt2: You can change your password later. Backup copies made earlier still open with the old password, because each copy is a file of its own and does not change after the fact. If you would rather not have that, delete the older copies once you have made a new one.
texte.hilfe:speichern-sicherung.einleitung: Your depot lives on this device, inside this application. Whatever you enter is stored there, and the display tells you when everything is up to date. None of it travels over the network.
texte.hilfe:speichern-sicherung.abschnitt0: A backup copy makes your depot independent of this device. Use the menu entry for creating a backup copy: it produces a single encrypted file that you can keep wherever you like, on a USB stick, on another computer, in your own filing.
texte.hilfe:speichern-sicherung.abschnitt1: Make such a copy from time to time, especially after you have entered a lot. Devices reclaim storage, get lost or get replaced. A copy kept somewhere else is the only protection against that, and it is encrypted just as the depot is.
texte.hilfe:speichern-sicherung.abschnitt2: After making it, check that the file really arrived, and remember where you put it. If the application cannot save on this device by itself, it tells you so; from then on the backup copy is not a spare, it is your depot.
texte.hilfe:eintragen-dokumente.einleitung: Your depot is divided into areas. In each area you enter whatever applies to you, and anything may be left empty. Under “My documents” you can also store files and scans, a scanned power of attorney for instance.
texte.hilfe:eintragen-dokumente.abschnitt0: Start with one thing. People who set out to sort everything at once usually stop before they finish. A single entry that is correct is worth more than ten half-finished ones, and you can carry on whenever you like.
texte.hilfe:eintragen-dokumente.abschnitt1: Much of this is meant as a pointer rather than a store: where a contract is kept, who knows about it, which number belongs to what. A document belongs in the depot when it will be needed in an emergency and would otherwise be hard to find.
texte.hilfe:eintragen-dokumente.abschnitt2: Some of it you need not type at all. When an organisation sends you a confirmed record, the application takes the values into the fields and notes where they came from. A report or a letter, by contrast, is kept as the document it is, together with a note of its origin.
texte.hilfe:weitergeben-empfaengerin.einleitun: Under “Share records” you put together what another person or organisation is to receive. You choose the area it comes from, and before anything leaves you see what the selection contains.
texte.hilfe:weitergeben-empfaengerin.abschnitt: Only what you selected goes out. The rest stays in the depot. The selection is a file or a PDF of its own; your depot itself never leaves the device, and the recipient gets no access to it.
The recipient does not need to install anything. A selection opens in a browser, a PDF like any other. They can see when the records were put together and who they came from.
If you withheld anything, the selection says so. The recipient therefore knows that something was left out, but not what it was. That keeps withholding from looking like completeness.
texte.hilfe:sensibel-zurueckhalten-freigeben.e: Some records are protected more strictly than others, diagnoses, medication or insurance details among them. They do not travel automatically, not even when you share a whole area.
texte.hilfe:sensibel-zurueckhalten-freigeben.a: You release those one by one under “Withhold”. Withholding is the starting state, releasing is the deliberate act. You decide afresh for every selection, and a release you granted yesterday does not carry over to tomorrow.
An explicit no is a record too, and you can keep it without handing it on. It stays explained inside your depot and does not travel. The selection then only states that something was withheld.
texte.hilfe:notfallkarte.einleitung: In the emergency area the application produces a printable emergency card as a PDF. It carries the records that matter in an emergency, short enough to be taken in within seconds.
texte.hilfe:notfallkarte.abschnitt0: The card belongs in a wallet, not on a device. It works without power, without a network and without a password, and that is exactly its purpose: it helps at the moment when nobody can unlock a device.
texte.hilfe:notfallkarte.abschnitt1: Because it can be read without a password, it should carry only what is genuinely needed. Print it again when something important changes, and do not keep it together with the device or the USB stick.
texte.hilfe:module-templates-echtheit.titel: Add-ons and where they come from
texte.hilfe:module-templates-echtheit.einleitu: An add-on brings further content into your depot: different labels, a different legal framework, or fields of its own for a particular subject. It stays on this device and is shown to nobody.
texte.hilfe:module-templates-echtheit.abschnit: Every add-on states where it came from. “Verified” means a recognised body signed it and the application checked that signature. There is also “signed, not recognised”, “unsigned” and “origin unknown”. Read that line before admitting anything you did not ask for yourself.

The check tells you who issued something, not whether its content is right for you. The body that published it answers for the content. {marke} confirms the origin and does not rewrite what others wrote.

Fields that an add-on brings with it belong to that add-on. Remove it and you can no longer reach what you entered there. So hand those entries on beforehand, or note them somewhere else in your depot.
texte.hilfe:datei-ist-das-depot.einleitung: There is no sign-in and no tie to a particular device. A backup copy is your complete depot in one file, and that file is all you need.
texte.hilfe:datei-ist-das-depot.abschnitt0: Copy it onto a USB stick or the other computer and open it there with the same password. Nothing has to be transferred, unlocked or signed out of. Whatever you enter afterwards sits in the version you currently have open.
texte.hilfe:datei-ist-das-depot.abschnitt1: If you work on two devices in turn, take care to continue from the most recent version and to make a fresh copy afterwards. Older files stay readable, but they only know the state they were made in.
texte.hilfe:was-vivodepot-nicht-sieht.einleitu: The application opens no connection to the network. There is no account, no server and no central store where your records could arrive.
texte.hilfe:was-vivodepot-nicht-sieht.abschnit: We do not know what you enter, how much you enter, or whether you use the application at all. Admitting an add-on or producing a selection stays on your device as well. Nothing reports back to us, because there is no route for it.

The other side of that is stated above: where nothing is held by us, nothing can be restored by us either. Your password and your backup copies are therefore the only two things you need to look after.
texte.hilfe:sub-depot.titel: A second depot for someone else
texte.hilfe:sub-depot.einleitung: If you care for another person, you can carry their depot alongside your own. The application calls it a sub-depot. It appears in your list, but it has a password of its own and its contents stay separate from yours.
texte.hilfe:sub-depot.abschnitt0: An existing depot can be taken in under “Attach”: you pick the file and give it a name, and it appears in your list. The contents are taken over unchanged, and the password stays the one the file already had.
texte.hilfe:sub-depot.abschnitt1: When your responsibility ends, when a child comes of age for instance, you hand the depot back. Under “Hand over” you save it as a file of its own and then confirm the handover. Only with that confirmation does the encrypted content leave your own depot.
texte.hilfe:sub-depot.abschnitt2: The file you handed over is an ordinary depot from then on, with the same password it had all along. No new password is needed and no fresh start; the person simply carries on where you left off.

texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#1/healthCareGenera: He / she can make decisions in all questions regarding my medical treatment and all details regarding my outpatient or (semi-)inpatient care. He / she is authorized to assert my wishes as specified in an advance healthcare directive.
texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#1/healthCareMedica: In particular, he / she can give, refuse or withdraw consent to me receiving medical examinations, treatment or operations, even if there is a risk that I will die or my health will suffer serious or long-term damage if the measure is carried out, withheld or discontinued (Section 1829 (1) and (2) of the German Civil Code).

He / she is entitled to see my medical records and to authorize their disclosure to third parties. I hereby release all the doctors and other medical staff involved in my care from the obligation to maintain professional confidentiality towards the trusted person acting as my agent. Furthermore, this person is entitled to release all the doctors and other medical staff involved in my care from the obligation to maintain professional confidentiality towards third parties.
texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#1/3.einleitung: Where necessary, he / she can make decisions
texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#2/determinePlaceOf: He / she can determine the place of my residence.
texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#2/manageAnExisting: He / she can administer the rights and obligations arising from the tenancy agreement for my housing (including termination of the agreement) and liquidate the contents of my household.
texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#2/concludeAndTermi: He / she can conclude or terminate a new tenancy agreement.
He / she can conclude or terminate an agreement in accordance with the Act on Residential Homes and Care Contracts (previously the Act on Residential Accommodation).
texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#3/representationWi: He/she can represent me in dealings with the authorities, insurance companies, pension providers and social benefit agencies. This includes the granting of consent under data protection law.
texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#4/assetManagementG: He / she can manage my assets, carrying out any legal acts and transactions in Germany and abroad, making and receiving any declarations, and filing, amending and withdrawing applications. In particular, this includes:
having rights of disposal over assets of any kind (please also refer to Note 1 below)
texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#4/acceptPaymentsAn: receiving payments and objects of value
texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#4/enterIntoLiabili: entering into obligations (please also refer to Note 1 below)
texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#4/accountsCustodyA: making declarations of intent with regard to my accounts, depots and safes. He / she can represent me in transactions with credit institutions (please also refer to Note 2 below)
texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#4/transactionsExpr: He / she should not be able to perform the following transactions: {text}.
texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#4/7.text:
Notes:

1. Make sure you have the required type of authorization for real estate transactions, commercial business, or taking out consumer loans (see Number 2.1 / 6 of the “Betreuungsrecht” brochure on guardianship law).

2. In order to arrange a lasting power of attorney (LPA) for banking matters, please use the account / depot LPA provided by your bank or building society. This LPA entitles the authorized person (the “agent”) to carry out any transactions immediately related to the management of the account or depot. The agent is not granted any powers that are unnecessary for taking care of normal business (e. g. the conclusion of financial forward contracts). It is essential that you sign the account / depot LPA form on the premises of your bank or building society; this will allow you to dispel any subsequent doubts about the validity of the authorization. If you are unable to visit the premises of your bank or building society, ask them about other possible solutions.
texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#5/mailAndTelecommu: In the course of exercising this LPA, he / she can receive, open and read any post addressed to me. This also applies to e-mail. Furthermore, he / she can make decisions about telecommunications, including all forms of electronic communication. He / she can make any declarations required in this regard (e. g. the signing or termination of contracts).
texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#6/representationIn: He / she can represent me in court and take procedural steps of any kind.
texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#7/mayGrantASubPowe: He / she can delegate the power of attorney to another person
texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#8/alsoProposeTheAu: If legal guardianship is necessary despite the existence of this LPA, I request that the trusted person designated above is appointed as my guardian.
texte.dok:vorsorgevollmacht#9/appliesBeyondDea: The LPA continues to be applicable after my death.

texte.dok:patientenverfuegung#5/0.texte[0]: Der in meiner Patientenverfügung geäußerte Wille zu bestimmten ärztlichen und pflegerischen Maßnahmen soll von den behandelnden Ärztinnen und Ärzten und dem Behandlungsteam befolgt werden. Mein(e) Vertreter(in) – z. B. Bevollmächtigte(r)/Betreuer(in) – soll dafür Sorge tragen, dass mein Patientenwille durchgesetzt wird.
texte.dok:patientenverfuegung#5/0.texte[1]: Sollte eine Ärztin oder ein Arzt oder das Behandlungsteam nicht bereit sein, meinen in dieser Patientenverfügung geäußerten Willen zu befolgen, erwarte ich, dass für eine anderweitige medizinische und/oder pflegerische Behandlung gesorgt wird. Von meiner Vertreterin/meinem Vertreter (z. B. Bevollmächtigte(r)/Betreuer(in)) erwarte ich, dass sie/er die weitere Behandlung so organisiert, dass meinem Willen entsprochen wird.
texte.dok:patientenverfuegung#5/whoseViewMatte: In Lebens- und Behandlungssituationen, die in dieser Patientenverfügung nicht konkret geregelt sind, ist mein mutmaßlicher Wille möglichst im Konsens aller Beteiligten zu ermitteln. Dafür soll diese Patientenverfügung als Richtschnur maßgeblich sein. Bei unterschiedlichen Meinungen über anzuwendende oder zu unterlassende ärztliche/pflegerische Maßnahmen soll der Auffassung folgender Person besondere Bedeutung zukommen:

Wenn ich meine Patientenverfügung nicht widerrufen habe, wünsche ich nicht, dass mir in der konkreten Anwendungssituation eine Änderung meines Willens unterstellt wird. Wenn aber die behandelnden Ärztinnen und Ärzte/das Behandlungsteam/mein(e) Bevollmächtigte(r)/Betreuer(in) aufgrund meiner Gesten, Blicke oder anderen Äußerungen die Auffassung vertreten, dass ich entgegen den Festlegungen in meiner Patientenverfügung doch behandelt oder nicht behandelt werden möchte, dann ist möglichst im Konsens aller Beteiligten zu ermitteln, ob die Festlegungen in meiner Patientenverfügung noch meinem aktuellen Willen entsprechen. Bei unterschiedlichen Meinungen soll in diesen Fällen der Auffassung folgender Person besondere Bedeutung zukommen:
